SECURITY EDUCATION
FIRST TERM PLAN LESSON NOTES
PRIMARY 1 (BASIC 1)
Each lesson is planned according to the the Lagos State Scheme of Work for Primary Schools. These are also useful for all the states across Nigeria by checking the state scheme of work before picking any lessons.
WEEKS/CONTENT LINKS
WEEK 1 - Concept of Security - Meaning of Security (Primary 1)
WEEK 2 - Concept of Security - Facts about Security (Primary 1)
WEEK 3 - Source of Insecurity (Primary 1)
WEEK 4 - Meaning and Examples of Security Alert Signs (Primary 1)
WEEK 5 - Security Colours and Their Meaning (Primary 1)
WEEK 6 - Security Gadgets (Primary 1)
WEEK 7 - Meaning of Home Security and Home Security Tips (Primary 1)
WEEK 8 - Office Security (Primary 1)
WEEK 9 - Personal Security at Home, School and on the Roads (Primary 1)
WEEK 10 - Revision
WEEK 11 - Revision
WEEK 12 - Examination
